title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Introduces the Transformer architecture, which relies entirely on self-attention instead of recurrence or convolution for sequence modeling tasks.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: Proposes a bidirectional transformer pre-trained on large text corpora that is fine-tuned for a wide range of language understanding tasks.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
summary: Introduces residual connections that let very deep convolutional networks train effectively, forming the basis of the ResNet family of models.

title: You Only Look Once: Unified Real-Time Object Detection
summary: Presents a single-pass neural network design for real-time object detection that predicts bounding boxes and class probabilities directly from full images.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Proposes a framework where a generator and a discriminator network are trained in opposition to produce realistic synthetic data.

title: Random Forests
summary: Describes an ensemble learning method that builds many decision trees and combines their predictions to improve accuracy and reduce overfitting.

title: A Few Useful Things to Know About Machine Learning
summary: Surveys practical lessons and common pitfalls that arise when applying machine learning methods to real-world problems.

title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Demonstrates an agent that learns to play Atari games directly from pixel input using a deep Q-network trained with reinforcement learning.

title: The Elements of Statistical Learning
summary: Provides a broad overview of statistical and machine learning methods for prediction including regression, classification, and resampling techniques.

title: A Survey on Data Mining Techniques
summary: Reviews common data mining techniques such as clustering, classification, and association rule mining, along with their typical applications.

title: Intrusion Detection Using Machine Learning: A Survey
summary: Surveys machine learning approaches used to detect network intrusions, comparing traditional and learning-based detection methods.

title: Deep Learning for Cyber Security Intrusion Detection
summary: Examines how deep learning models can be applied to identify malicious network traffic and improve intrusion detection accuracy.

title: Software-Defined Networking: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: Surveys the software-defined networking paradigm, covering its architecture, protocols such as OpenFlow, and deployment challenges.

title: A Survey of Mobile Ad Hoc Network Routing Protocols
summary: Reviews routing protocol families used in mobile ad hoc networks and compares their performance characteristics.

title: A Systematic Literature Review of Software Testing Techniques
summary: Reviews and categorizes software testing techniques reported in the literature, identifying common strategies and open challenges.

title: Agile Software Development Methods: A Comparative Review
summary: Compares popular agile development methodologies and discusses their suitability for different types of software projects.

title: A Survey of NoSQL Database Systems
summary: Surveys the design principles behind NoSQL databases and compares document, key-value, column-family, and graph data stores.

title: Query Optimization Techniques in Relational Database Systems
summary: Reviews query optimization strategies used by relational database management systems to improve execution efficiency.

title: Internet of Things: A Survey on Enabling Technologies and Protocols
summary: Surveys the architectures, communication protocols, and enabling technologies that underpin Internet of Things deployments.

title: Edge Computing for the Internet of Things: A Survey
summary: Reviews how edge computing architectures reduce latency and bandwidth use for Internet of Things applications.
